resources.author: O.S. Engines Mfg. Co., Ltd.
resources.inspection: Official 22-page combined manual downloaded and text-checked; page PDF 21 (printed page 40) rendered with pdftoppm and visually inspected. MAX-61FX specifications and three-view drawing show 9.95 cc / 0.607 cu in, 550 g, dimensions in mm, four Ø4.2 holes and UNF 5/16-24 prop shaft. Does not include airframe installation or the E-4010 silencer in the dimensioned engine view.
resources.rights_note: Manufacturer manual retained as a local research reference only. Preserve attribution and do not republish the PDF. The .61FX documents an engine class example; it does not select O.S. as the final brand.
